title: Joining and leading the Eureka Brass Band
summary: Howard tells how he got into the old Eureka band, was moved to the solo part, and became its leader.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Yeah. One other question here about the other brass bands that you belonged to. Did you belong to any other brass band when you started, besides from your own band that you led on the street?
I led the Eureka Brass Band. Is that right?
I didn't know you were, you played in the Eureka.

Yes. As Red, Red was playing trombone at that time. Willie Wilson was leading the band. In other words, that was his band, and Johnny Wilson. Johnny Wilson played the baritone. And I went into the band, and after he, and Shots, excuse me.
I remember Shots was in the Eureka band too.
I'm talking about the old Eureka band.

And, or, or, or, or, or, or, Ornis Rodgers. Yeah. Either one. Got me to come into the band. And, uh, you know, Shots and Wilson, they were talking. A fella, you don't know him, but name called him, Guy Sooner. He's a big, big, big, big, big, big, time guy. You see. And so they was talking about what part to give me. I was just mad at him, Roger, say, give me the part. Don't worry. And that's how I got the band. So anyway, they put me on the first part. Yeah. And I played, and they were surprised. Be taking care of my part. And then they hired me in the band. Well, Shots was always a wonderful second man. He fit for the first part, but he wasn't afraid to give me the solo. And after that, they put me on solo. And from that, they put me to be the leader. And I never would go to the rehearsal in my life. Was never there to come out there. But I was up on it good then. I used to love it, but I don't care for that.
Did you use quite a bit of music in those days? That's what I'm talking about.

That's the part, they had the music. They had the music. Yeah, they used to play the music. And I used to, after Wilson was taking a seat, they put that leader thing on my cap. And I did the band a long time.
